name: Hookshot Rails Self-Hosted Webhook Relay
free_limit: MIT-licensed Rails 8 self-hosted webhook receiver and relay with named inbound endpoints, routing filters, multiple delivery targets, replay, delivery retries and admin dashboard; no vendor-imposed software quota or expiry.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires Ruby 4, SQLite, Node.js for assets and your own server; no free managed webhook delivery or compute is included. Change insecure default HTTP Basic credentials (admin/changeme) before exposure, use HTTPS, protect the admin/MCP endpoint, validate incoming webhook sources and manage payload retention. Production Solid Queue worker is needed for retries and cleanup. License notices must be retained.
